import sys, time, json, base64, random, io, csv
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

random.seed(5)
nleases=124
leases=[]
for i in range(nleases):
    leases.append({'id':'L%03d'%i,'prefix':'2001:db8:%x:%x00::/56'%(i//16,i%16),
                   'start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':list(range(16)),'low_count':32})
# 200000 records over 16 captures
COLS='type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload'
def gen(idx):
    buf=io.StringIO()
    w=csv.writer(buf,lineterminator='\n')
    w.writerow(COLS.split(','))
    lease=leases[idx%len(leases)]
    base='2001:db8:%x:%x00::'%(int(lease['id'][1:])//16,int(lease['id'][1:])%16)
    for j in range(12500):
        lid=leases[(idx*12500+j)%len(leases)]
        b='2001:db8:%x:%x00::'%(int(lid['id'][1:])//16,int(lid['id'][1:])%16)
        sub=(j)%16
        low=(j%32)+1
        target='%s%d'%(b,low)
        kind='icmp' if j%3 else 'app'
        if kind=='icmp':
            w.writerow(['icmp','r%06d'%j,'1','5','put',lid['id'],'1','%d/i%d'%(sub,low),
                        target,target,'echo','','',''])
        else:
            w.writerow(['app','a%06d'%j,'1','5','put',lid['id'],'2','',target,'',
                        'closed','web','0',''])
    return buf.getvalue().encode()
captures=[]
for i in range(16):
    captures.append({'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(gen(i)).decode()]})
job=base_job(leases=leases,queries=[10,20],captures=captures,
             services=[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}])
data=json.dumps(job).encode()
print('input size %.1f MiB'%(len(data)/1024/1024))
import subprocess,os
t=time.time()
proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                     input=data,capture_output=True,env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/workspace','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C','TMPDIR':'/workspace/tmp'})
print('elapsed %.2fs rc=%d out=%d bytes stderr=%s'%(time.time()-t,proc.returncode,len(proc.stdout),proc.stderr[:400].decode()))
out=json.loads(proc.stdout)
print('manifest',len(out['manifest']),'rejected',len(out['rejected']),'snapshots',len(out['snapshots']))
print('ledger',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'])
PYEOF
